race.comment: The ho favourites comes out after winning at Sandown yesterday. That leaves LOUELLA FLY (9) on top, a filly by Doubtland on debut for the Dabernig yard. She's looked sharp winning a recent jumpout and draws well. Expect she takes some beating. HINEY'S BAR (1) resumes having shown some ability in two runs last time in, look for a market push in a winnable race. EMPRESS ROSSA (3) has just found one better in both starts to date, 1100m on her home deck and Meech on should see her hard to run down having handled the conditions well in both runs.  PIPOLI DIVA (6) might be next best off a better run at Moe last time out.
